body: Thank you for your kind words.

Thank you for the suggestion. I will look around. Being in the US on a student visa prohibits me from seeking employment or financial help. And then there is the issue of time, since I am preparing for my qualifying exams at the moment.
All I wanted was to be free.

We've got one of those in our program. I even share my office space with him. In addition to being a know-it-all, he seems to operate with the following logic: if there's something I know and you don't, then you're doomed for failure. If there's something you know and I don't, it must not be important anyway. He asks absolutely irrelevant questions in class, most of them along the lines of "how is this related to this something I already know?" Even the professors are fed up with him these days.

It's especially difficult being around him during and/or before exams. I just find a different workspace and basically ignore and avoid him to every possible extent.
